name: Astryx Chat Composer Drawer

files.content:
"use client"

import "./astryx-chat-composer-drawer-utils/index.css"
import { ChatComposerDrawer } from "@astryxdesign/core/Chat"

export * from "@astryxdesign/core/Chat"
export default ChatComposerDrawer

The component and demo TSX are the exact public21st originals. Their local generated CSS was not included by the source connector. This example deliberately uses official @astryxdesign/core0.7.16 reset/astryx CSS through a small local adapter. It is not the recovered original generated CSS and pixel identity is not certified. The public dependency remains required for editable integration. Keep its MIT license and these limitations.

Install the verified public dependencies with npm install @astryxdesign/core@0.7.16 @stylexjs/stylex@0.19.2 @heroicons/react@2.2.0. React and react-dom must be version19 or newer. The supplied local CSS adapter imports the official reset and component styles; preserve it alongside the unchanged TSX wrapper. No original generated per-example CSS was recovered. The original demo explicitly selects a fixed light theme; its isolated host follows that same light stage for readable contrast.
